The '''Wookiee sanctuary'''<ref name="WookieeSanctuary">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/tribe-episode-guide|text="Tribe" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} {{C|Concept Art Gallery: slide 10}}</ref> was a [[Wookiee]] village deep in the [[forest]]s of the [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]]. [[Yanna]] was the elder and leader of the sanctuary.<ref name="Tribe" /> At some point between [[19 BBY]] and [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Clone Force 99]] rescued the Wookiee [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Gungi]], and [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Clone Force 99)|brought him]] to the safety of the village. With the help of the Wookiee village tribesmen, they defeated the [[Trandoshan]] and [[clone trooper]] forces that were led by [[Commander]] [[Babwa Venomor]]. In the process, the Bad Batch and the Wookiees used shovels to extinguish the [[Fire|flames]] that Venomor launched from his [[flame cannon]] as well as the flames from his troops' [[incinerator tank]]s, preventing them from spreading to the sanctuary.<ref name="Tribe" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Wookiee sanctuary first appeared in "[[Tribe]]," the sixth episode of the [[The Bad Batch Season 2|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', which premiered on [[February 1]], [[2023]].<ref name="BB S2">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-trailer-key-art|text=Clone Force 99 Is Back in New ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 2 Trailer}}</ref> It was first identified in the Concept Art Gallery for "Tribe," in a piece of concept art by [[Christian Piccolo]].<ref name="WookieeSanctuary" /> Another piece of concept art by Piccolo depicts the interior of the Wookiee sanctuary.<ref name="Interiorconcept">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/tribe-episode-guide|text="Tribe" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} {{C|Concept Art Gallery: slide 13}}</ref>
